{"execution_owner":{"host":"operator-host","pid":2810274,"uid":1000},"wait":{"owner":"node","nodeId":"plan-gate","kind":"attention","waitingSince":"2026-10-31T12:52:00.627Z","message":"GATE 2 — the plan. Ready to build: true
Summary: The plan adds an optional profile block, stack.preflight, with tools, TCP services (each with an optional start command) and min_disk_free_pct (default 20; 0 turns the disk check off). profile.ts validates the block, load-profile emits it only when present, and factory.yaml declares it as an optional field.

The checks live in a new lib, _lib/preflight.ts:
- missing tools are reported together;
- low disk runs the existing PILOT-470 leftovers cleanup and measures again;
- a down service is started once (120 s cap) and polled for 60 s.

The lib runs in two places:
- A new preflight node after load-profile and before sync-base, with a preflight-stop cancel node modelled on claude-auth-stop.
- Inside merge-gate.ts, right before the command loop. A failure refuses with a new class, 'preflight', which takes the existing not-delivered path and leaves the PR open. merge passes the binding through, so the gate's re-run after a conflict rebase checks again.

A spike showed that Archon binds "" for a declared but absent field, so a profile without the block behaves exactly as before and the 22 existing fixtures need no edits. Node timeouts grow by the preflight's bounded 1200 s.

The rest of the change:
- project-be (postgres and redis, check-only because the template has no compose file) and project-fe profile templates;
- two new fixtures: stop before work, and stop before the merge gate;
- archon-check.sh trace assertions, unit tests, docs, and a CHANGELOG Added entry.
